Headline: Your neighborhood plumber for leaks, drains and water heaters
Subheadline: From a dripping faucet to a new water heater, C&A Plumbing finds the problem, explains the fix and gets your water running right again.
About: We are a local plumbing company serving homes and businesses in Laurel and across Howard County. Everyday repairs or bigger projects, we explain the work and the price before we start.
Services:
Leak repair | Finding and fixing leaks in pipes, faucets and fixtures before they cause damage.
Drain cleaning | Clearing slow or blocked sinks, tubs, toilets and main lines.
Water heaters | Repair and replacement of tank and tankless water heaters.
Fixture installation | New faucets, toilets, sinks and showers, fitted properly.
Pipe repair | Repairing or replacing damaged and ageing pipes.
Sump pumps | Installing and servicing sump pumps to keep basements dry.
Highlights:
Clear quote first | You know the price before any work begins.
Respect for your home | Tidy work areas and care around your floors and fixtures.
Local to Laurel | Serving homes and businesses across Howard County.
Steps:
Call or email | Tell us what is happening and where.
Get a clear quote | We look at the problem and explain your options.
Fixed and tested | We finish the job and check everything works.
